judge.rationale: The candidate uses completely wrong frame and type names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`, `sessions`) instead of what the issue explicitly specifies (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, `conversations`). It also violates a core requirement by returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when the store lacks `listFor` instead of returning an `error` frame with `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`. Furthermore, the candidate completely omits the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in configuration, allows `limit: 0` and unbounded limits instead of enforcing 1–200, and logs the raw database error message (`error.message`) on failure. Finally, it leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the tree and skips the required updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`.
